info.name: Rental Car Booking API
info.description:
All routes of the Rental Car Booking REST API (2110503 final project).

Run the folders top to bottom (Collection Runner / Newman): each request saves the ids and tokens the next ones need into collection variables.

Before running: set `adminEmail` / `adminPassword` to the seeded admin account (ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD in config/config.env). A full run is ~60 requests, so raise RATE_LIMIT_MAX if you hit 429.

exec: // One run id per run, so registered emails / provider names / plates stay unique

request.description: Admins only come from `npm run seed`.
Cookies are disabled for this request; otherwise the token cookie set by login would authenticate it.
Provider role: owner is set to the logged-in account. One provider per provider account.
?start=&end= returns only cars free for the whole range. Also supports ?provider=<id>.
Whitelisted fields: brand, model, licensePlate, type, seats, dailyRate.

item.name: Get provider's pick-up locations by region

request.description: Only role user can book. pickupLocation is optional and must belong to the car's provider.
A rejected request is replaced by a new one.

item.name: Approve pick-up request (+ add to list)

request.description: addToList: true also creates a PickupLocation (region must be in serviceRegions).
Also deletes its cars, pick-up locations, pick-up requests and bookings.
